title: Casper and the Blue Hour
author: Isandro Iversen
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
